sys_atf_test.description: Tests that the supplier-threshold-check before-update business rule changes a supplier status to under_review when the cumulative_score drops below threshold_score. Creates a supplier with threshold_score=50, then creates the full prerequisite chain (procurement order, material receipt, quality check, procurement report) needed for a supplier rating. Inserts a supplier rating with score 30, which triggers recalc-supplier-score to set cumulative_score=30. Since 30 < 50 (threshold), the supplier-threshold-check BR sets status to under_review. Validates the status change and cleans up all records.
sys_atf_test.name: Supplier Threshold Alert Test
